scope.description: On one real single-node Raft instance over a transport that implements the heartbeat fast path, hold the main loop's next term write open through an instrumented stable store, deliver one empty heartbeat with a much higher term on the fast path while it is held, then release and emit one CA_EVENT JSON line recording the term and the persisted term before the hold, inside the hold after the heartbeat, and after the release, together with the node's state.
assumptions: The instrumented store implements the same interface as the in-memory store and blocks only the first write of the current term after being armed; the window it holds open is the existing gap between the election's read-modify-write of the term and its store, so no production logic is changed and the harness only widens a window that exists.
The node is deposed by a real empty heartbeat with a higher term, so the election that follows is the node's own timer-driven election rather than a direct state poke.
The heartbeat delivered during the hold carries a term far above the current one, so a release that lands a lower term is unambiguous rather than a near tie.
The wrapper transport reproduces the network transport's classification and dispatch, so the handler under test is the production processHeartbeat and the appendEntries it calls.

basis.prefix: The harness (draft/assurance_generated_test.go) is one TestAssurance-prefixed test plus two local helper types. It creates an in-memory transport, wraps it in a type that installs and fast-paths strictly empty AppendEntries requests on the caller's goroutine with a bounded response wait, wraps the in-memory store in a type that can be armed to block the next write of the current term while signalling that it has been entered, bootstraps a single-voter configuration with BootstrapCluster and starts the node with NewRaft over those objects, then waits (bounded) for Leader state. It records the term as leader and delivers an empty heartbeat one term above it, which depose the node; it arms the store gate immediately afterwards and waits (bounded, five seconds) for the gate to be entered, which is the main loop's election write being held open, recording the term and state at that moment. It then delivers a second empty heartbeat with a term ten above the current one on the fast path, records the response, the in-memory term and the persisted term, releases the gate, waits briefly, and records the in-memory term, the persisted term and the node's state again. All operands are printed in one CA_EVENT JSON line, and the node is shut down at the end.
